scripts.build:preload: cross-env VETTA_PRELOAD_ENTRY=index vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && cross-env VETTA_PRELOAD_ENTRY=pet vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && cross-env VETTA_PRELOAD_ENTRY=quickpanel vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && cross-env VETTA_PRELOAD_ENTRY=onboarding vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:presets && bun run build:themes && bun run build:preload && bun run build:ocr-preload && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:ocr-runner && bun run build:main
scripts.build:ocr-runner:dev: bun run prepare:ocr-models && bun run build:ocr-runner
scripts.build:dev-processes: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "preload,ocr-preload,ocr-runner,main" "cross-env VETTA_BUILD_ENV=development bun run build:preload" "bun run build:ocr-preload" "bun run build:ocr-runner:dev" "cross-env VETTA_BUILD_ENV=development bun run build:main"
scripts.start: bun run prepare:windows && bun run prepare:ocr-models && bun run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' electron src/main/main.ts
scripts.dev: bun run prepare:windows:dev && node scripts/build-appshot-helper.js && cross-env VETTA_THEME_DEV_SERVER=1 concurrently -k --success command-electron --names "renderer,themes,electron" "bun run build:presets:dev && bun run stage:themes:dev && bun ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --config vite.config.ts" "bun run dev:themes" "bun run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:verify: bun run prepare:windows:dev && node scripts/build-appshot-helper.js && concurrently -k --success command-electron --names "renderer,electron" "bun run build:presets:dev && bun run build:themes && bun ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --config vite.config.ts" "bun run dev:electron"
scripts.prebuild:pack: bun run clean && bun run prepare:windows && bun run prepare:bwrap && bun run prepare:ocr-models && bun run build && node scripts/prepare-pack.js
scripts.pack:linux: cross-env VETTA_VENDOR_PLATFORM=linux-x64 VETTA_CLI_TARGET_PLATFORMS=linux-x64 bun run dist:desktop -- --platform linux --target dir
scripts.pack:win: cross-env VETTA_VENDOR_PLATFORM=win32-x64 VETTA_CLI_TARGET_PLATFORMS=win32-x64 bun run dist:desktop -- --platform win --target dir
scripts.dist:linux: cross-env VETTA_VENDOR_PLATFORM=linux-x64 VETTA_CLI_TARGET_PLATFORMS=linux-x64 bun run dist:desktop -- --platform linux
scripts.dist:win: cross-env VETTA_VENDOR_PLATFORM=win32-x64 VETTA_CLI_TARGET_PLATFORMS=win32-x64 bun run dist:desktop -- --platform win
scripts.dist:linux:appimage: cross-env VETTA_VENDOR_PLATFORM=linux-x64 VETTA_CLI_TARGET_PLATFORMS=linux-x64 bun run dist:desktop -- --platform linux --target AppImage
scripts.dist:linux:deb: cross-env VETTA_VENDOR_PLATFORM=linux-x64 VETTA_CLI_TARGET_PLATFORMS=linux-x64 bun run dist:desktop -- --platform linux --target deb
scripts.dist:linux:rpm: cross-env VETTA_VENDOR_PLATFORM=linux-x64 VETTA_CLI_TARGET_PLATFORMS=linux-x64 bun run dist:desktop -- --platform linux --target rpm
scripts.dist:linux:tar.gz: cross-env VETTA_VENDOR_PLATFORM=linux-x64 VETTA_CLI_TARGET_PLATFORMS=linux-x64 bun run dist:desktop -- --platform linux --target tar.gz
scripts.dist:win:inno: cross-env VETTA_VENDOR_PLATFORM=win32-x64 VETTA_CLI_TARGET_PLATFORMS=win32-x64 bun run dist:desktop -- --platform win --target inno
scripts.dist:win:portable: cross-env VETTA_VENDOR_PLATFORM=win32-x64 VETTA_CLI_TARGET_PLATFORMS=win32-x64 bun run dist:desktop -- --platform win --target portable
scripts.dist:win:zip: cross-env VETTA_VENDOR_PLATFORM=win32-x64 VETTA_CLI_TARGET_PLATFORMS=win32-x64 bun run dist:desktop -- --platform win --target zip
